symptom_summary: fever, cough, fatigue, body aches
advice: Rest, fluids, and over-the-counter fever reducers. See a doctor if fever exceeds 39C or lasts more than 3 days.

symptom_summary: runny nose, sneezing, itchy eyes, no fever
advice: Antihistamines usually help. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond a couple of weeks.

symptom_summary: sore throat, difficulty swallowing, swollen glands
advice: A doctor can test for strep with a throat swab; antibiotics may be needed if positive.

symptom_summary: persistent cough over 3 weeks, night sweats, weight loss
possible_condition: Possible tuberculosis or chronic respiratory infection
advice: See a doctor promptly for chest imaging and further testing.

symptom_summary: shortness of breath, chest tightness, wheezing
advice: See a doctor for evaluation; seek emergency care if breathing is severely labored.

symptom_summary: sudden chest pain, pain radiating to arm or jaw, sweating
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: headache, sensitivity to light, stiff neck, fever
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: mild headache, tiredness, stress
advice: Rest, hydration, and over-the-counter pain relief usually help. See a doctor if headaches become frequent or severe.

symptom_summary: one-sided throbbing headache, nausea, light sensitivity
advice: See a doctor for management options if migraines are frequent or severe.

symptom_summary: dizziness, lightheadedness when standing
possible_condition: Possible low blood pressure or dehydration
advice: Increase fluids and stand up slowly. See a doctor if it happens often.

symptom_summary: abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite
advice: Bland diet and rest often help. See a doctor if pain is severe or persistent.

symptom_summary: severe abdominal pain, lower right side, fever
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: diarrhea, stomach cramps, mild fever
advice: Stay hydrated with oral rehydration solutions. See a doctor if symptoms last more than 2 days or you notice blood.

symptom_summary: heartburn, burning sensation in chest after eating
advice: Avoid trigger foods and consider antacids. See a doctor if symptoms are frequent.

symptom_summary: joint pain, swelling, stiffness in the morning
advice: See a doctor for evaluation and imaging if symptoms persist.

symptom_summary: muscle aches, cramping after exercise
advice: Rest, stretch, and hydrate. See a doctor if pain doesn't improve in a few days.

symptom_summary: back pain after lifting, worse with movement
advice: Rest and gentle movement usually help. See a doctor if pain radiates down a leg or doesn't improve.

symptom_summary: lower back pain, pain radiating down leg, numbness
advice: See a doctor for evaluation, especially if numbness or weakness is present.

symptom_summary: burning sensation when urinating, frequent urination
advice: See a doctor; UTIs are usually easily treated with antibiotics.

symptom_summary: increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision
advice: See a doctor for blood sugar testing.

symptom_summary: skin rash, itching, redness
advice: Avoid the irritant and consider antihistamines. See a doctor if the rash spreads or doesn't improve.

symptom_summary: hives, swelling of lips or face, difficulty breathing
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: persistent acne, oily skin
advice: Over-the-counter treatments often help. See a dermatologist if it doesn't improve.

symptom_summary: ear pain, reduced hearing, fluid draining from ear
advice: See a doctor for evaluation; may need antibiotics.

symptom_summary: red, itchy, watery eyes with discharge
advice: See a doctor; can be contagious. Avoid touching or sharing towels.

symptom_summary: toothache, swelling of gums, sensitivity to hot or cold
advice: See a dentist promptly; untreated dental infections can worsen.

symptom_summary: anxiety, racing heart, trouble sleeping, restlessness
advice: Consider speaking with a doctor or mental health professional.

symptom_summary: persistent sadness, loss of interest, low energy for weeks
advice: Consider speaking with a doctor or mental health professional.

symptom_summary: difficulty sleeping, waking up frequently at night
advice: Improve sleep habits and reduce screen time before bed. See a doctor if it persists.

symptom_summary: swelling in legs or ankles, shortness of breath
possible_condition: Possible fluid retention or heart-related issue
advice: See a doctor promptly for evaluation.

symptom_summary: numbness or weakness on one side of the body, slurred speech
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: nosebleed, easy bruising, unusual bleeding
advice: See a doctor if bleeding is frequent, heavy, or unexplained.

symptom_summary: loss of smell or taste, mild cough, fatigue
advice: Rest and monitor symptoms. See a doctor if breathing becomes difficult.

symptom_summary: vomiting blood or black stools
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: persistent fatigue, pale skin, shortness of breath on exertion
advice: See a doctor for blood testing.

symptom_summary: weight loss without trying, persistent fatigue
advice: See a doctor for evaluation and testing.

symptom_summary: cold hands and feet, fatigue, weight gain
advice: See a doctor for thyroid function testing.

symptom_summary: nausea, vomiting, high fever, confusion
advice: This can be a medical emergency. Seek emergency care immediately.

symptom_summary: mild fever, body rash, joint pain after travel
advice: See a doctor promptly, especially if you've recently traveled to an affected area.
